description: This course will move beyond Hollywood and popular cinema's proposals of celebrity, assimilation, and visibility as the ultimate markers of liberation for trans and gender-nonconforming people. It will take the documentarian’s camera and consider its uniquely queer potential. How have queer filmmakers used the audio, visual, and temporal components of cinema to transform reality into uniquely queer worlds? Students will engage directly with queer cinema, analyzing the formal techniques at play and their effect on the viewer. We will then put these ideas into practice in a series of creative projects inspired by and modeled after the works of queer documentary filmmakers.
name: Top: Queering Documentary
title: Topics: Film and Media Modes
